expectations.text: Sizes each beat to roughly one thought and about twenty seconds of narration.
expectations.evidence: Beats are timed at 30–60s (00:00–00:30, 00:30–01:05, 01:05–01:40, 01:40–02:15, 02:15–02:50, 02:50–03:50), well above about 20s. Several beats carry more than one thought. The hook tells a typo story, pitches the product, previews five sections and lists prerequisites. The generated-SQL beat covers both parameter binding and closing the injection gap. The type-errors beat runs 60s and covers two separate errors with two demo pauses. The script never states a per-beat sizing rule, and its runtime math covers the whole script only.

expectations.text: Sizes each beat to roughly one thought and about twenty seconds of narration.
expectations.evidence: The beats run 40–55 seconds each (0:00–0:40, 0:40–1:35, 1:35–2:20, 2:20–3:00, 3:00–3:50). Only the 10-second close is short. Several beats pack in more than one idea. Beat 1 covers fragility, typo checking, missing parameters, dynamic WHERE splicing, testability and injection. Beat 2 covers method chaining, typed autocomplete, naming conventions and conditional filters. None are cut down to one thought of about 20 seconds.
